pcg_kernels.cuh adapts update_xr_kernel and update_p_kernel from
src/backends/cuda/linear_system/linear_pcg.cu at the pinned revision.
Changes: raw device pointers replace cuda_tool vector views; Float becomes
double; names and namespace match PGO; surrounding engine registration,
configuration, logging and debug export dependencies are omitted.

PGO's cudaNewtonSolver.cu follows the zero-initial-guess Jacobi-PCG recurrence
from LinearPCG::pcg in that source: r=b, z=P*r, p=z, alpha=(r*z)/(p*A*p),
fused x/r updates, z=P*r, beta=(r_new*z_new)/(r*z), p=z+beta*p.
Local additions: explicit nonpositive-curvature/nonfinite detection,
regularization retries, Euclidean relative/absolute residual tolerance and
true-residual verification. cuBLAS supplies device dot/norm reductions.
No SimSystem, upstream World/Scene API or whole backend is linked.
